chosen_title: Woman with Alzheimer's starts conversing again after taking psilocybin
caption: A woman with severe Alzheimer's who hadn't spoken more than monosyllables in years began initiating real conversation — after a single dose of psilocybin. Source: New Scientist. #Alzheimers #Psilocybin #BrainHealth #Neuroscience #MagicMushrooms #DementiaResearch #MedicalBreakthrough #ScienceNews #DecodeDaily #HealthNews

slides.label: THE TREATMENT
slides.caption: A woman with severe Alzheimer's — silent beyond monosyllables for years — began initiating conversation after a single administration of psilocybin.

slides.label: WHY IT MATTERS
points: She hadn't spoken beyond monosyllables in years — then one dose changed that
Psilocybin triggered conversation she initiated herself, not just responses
No approved drug today can reverse severe Alzheimer's decline
This single case could accelerate psilocybin trials in dementia globally
